children: PHINIA Inc. (

), a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, precision machined components and aftermarket solutions, today announced it has entered into a definitive asset purchase agreement to acquire the core operating business assets, brand rights, and capabilities of the FMP Group with operations in Australia, Thailand and Malaysia ("FMP Group"), a leading Asia-Pacific automotive aftermarket business that designs, produces and sells premium brake components.
Transaction Highlights

Strengthens PHINIA’s financial growth profile. PHINIA will acquire the core operating business assets, brand rights, and capabilities of the FMP Group with operations in Australia, Thailand and Malaysia, for approximately $160 million. PHINIA expects the transaction to contribute approximately $120 million of annual revenue and $23 million of annual adjusted EBITDA and be accretive to earnings.

Expands PHINIA’s presence in the attractive Asia-Pacific aftermarket. Adds established customer relationships and a broader propulsion-agnostic product portfolio across light passenger vehicle, commercial vehicle, motorcycle, and specialty applications.

Adds a trusted brand while expanding PHINIA’s existing brake components portfolio. Includes rights to use the market-leading Bendix brand in Australia and certain Asia-Pacific markets. The Bendix brand is recognized for premium brake components, with strong preference among mechanics and distributors.
Contributes a vertically integrated model that includes in-house development, testing, manufacturing, and distribution capabilities, providing a solid foundation for future innovation and growth.

Creates opportunities to accelerate product and geographic expansion. The acquired engineering skills are expected to significantly expand our braking capabilities and support faster new product development, expansion into adjacent categories, and broader deployment of aftermarket solutions globally.

Brady Ericson, President and Chief Executive Officer of PHINIA, commented: “In line with our stated strategy, we continue to be disciplined and focused on acquisitions that strengthen our business at the right price. This transaction meets that standard and is an attractive business acquired at a compelling valuation. This acquisition gives our aftermarket business a strong regional platform, while preserving the financial flexibility to support our other capital allocation priorities. We look forward to welcoming the FMP Group team to PHINIA.”
Financial and Transaction Overview

PHINIA expects to fund the transaction with available liquidity. The transaction is structured as an asset acquisition under which PHINIA will acquire the operating assets of the business and assume specified liabilities associated with those operations. Under the agreement, historical asbestos liabilities and certain other legacy liabilities of the sellers are excluded and will not be assumed by PHINIA. The proposed transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals, confirmatory insolvency proceedings, and other customary closing conditions.
About PHINIA

PHINIA is a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, with a strong portfolio of trusted brands that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY®, HARTRIDGE™ and stoba®. With over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, PHINIA has approximately 13,500 talented employees and over 40 locations in 21 countries and is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA.

Our systems and solutions are designed to keep combustion engines operating at peak performance across a variety of applications: medium- and heavy-duty commercial vehicle (on-road vehicles used for commercial transport classified class 4-8, 14,001 pounds or heavier), light commercial vehicle (on-road vehicles used for commercial transport classified as class 1-3, 14,000 pounds or lighter), light passenger vehicle (on-road vehicles used primarily for carrying passengers), and off-highway, industrial, and other (including construction and agricultural machinery, vocational vehicles, marine, industrial applications, power generation, and aerospace and defense).

PHINIA’s service solutions include vehicle repair and replacement parts, offering both new and remanufactured products through the original equipment manufacturer dealer network and the independent aftermarket channel.

By delivering high-performance solutions today and investing in advanced technologies to unlock the potential of alternative fuels in contributing to lower carbon mobility, PHINIA is shaping a more efficient and sustainable future.
